content.text:
help exit=0
usage: dcat_catalog_check.py [-h] [--url URL] [--log_file LOG_FILE]
                             [--results RESULTS] [--verbose] [--debug]
                             [--recheck] [--save-catalog] [--no-recheck]
                             [--access-url-as-download]
                             [--check-format CHECK_FORMAT]
                             [--force-check-format FORCE_CHECK_FORMAT]
                             [--check-http-5xx]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --url URL             DCAT catalog URL
  --log_file LOG_FILE   Log file path
  --results RESULTS     File from which the results are loaded
  --verbose             Enable verbose logging
  --debug               Enable debug logging
  --recheck             Only use the previous results (specified by --results)
                        as input for the next check
  --save-catalog        Save the DCAT catalog into a file catalog.xml
  --no-recheck          Just check new entries from the catalog. Do not re-
                        check existing results.
  --access-url-as-download
                        Treat the dcat:accessURL as the download URL.
  --check-format CHECK_FORMAT
                        Only check the specified format
  --force-check-format FORCE_CHECK_FORMAT
                        Check distributinons with the specified format
                        regardless of previous results
  --check-http-5xx      Only re-check HTTP 5xx errors
---ERR---
---GDAL---
gdal version 3.8.4
gdal OK
gdal exit=0

observation.command: cd /workspace && poetry run python dcat_catalog_check.py --help > /tmp/help.txt 2>/tmp/help.err; echo "help exit=$?"; head -30 /tmp/help.txt; echo "---ERR---"; cat /tmp/help.err; echo "---GDAL---"; poetry run python -c "from osgeo import gdal; print('gdal version', gdal.__version__); print('gdal OK')"; echo "gdal exit=$?"
